Source contracts: scripts/installer_support.sh

scripts/installer_support.sh

Shell · Tier B

Shared consent, progress and command logging for source installers.

Usage

Source from Linux/macOS installers; compatible with macOS Bash 3.2.

Inputs

INSTALL_VERBOSE selects full command output. Approval belongs to the caller.

Side effects

Runs installer commands, displaying progress on stderr and capturing quiet command output in private temporary logs. Privilege prompts remain foregrounded.

Cleanup

Stops the progress worker on exit or interruption; retains only failed logs.
